article.story: NEW ROCHELLE, N.Y. -- — Keyshawn Mitchell scored 13 points as Iona beat UMKC 62-61 on Friday. Aiden Disu made 1 of 2 foul shots with two seconds left. He missed the second free throw, but teammate Alliou Fall grabbed the offensive rebound to seal the win. Mitchell also contributed eight rebounds for the Gaels (3-4). Kevon Vanderhorst scored 13 points and added five rebounds and five assists. Ore Odutayo had 12 points and went 4 of 8 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range). Lincoln Goodwin led the Roos (3-4) in scoring, finishing with 19 points. Assane Diop added 15 points and 10 rebounds for UMKC. Carl Daughtery Jr. also had nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
